purpose: Requirements for document search: finding task-relevant documents from the ToC without omissions, pre-search rebuild checks and user choices, and the contents of search results.
summary: FR-006 document search from a task, prioritizing no omissions over precision
Search uses the ToC of the specified key, or the reserved key all when omitted
If the ToC does not exist, search is refused and initial build is requested
Pre-search check of rebuild necessity using the stored Index target specification
When rebuild is needed, the user chooses between rebuilding first or searching the existing ToC
Confirmation shows rebuild scale counts; details go to a work file
If necessity cannot be determined, search stops as a failure with no stale-ToC option
Searching the existing ToC notifies that it may not reflect current documents and does not recommit it
Search results include document ID, recorded path, reason, sections and ToC state
Acceptance criterion AC-019 for pre-search ToC rebuild confirmation
tasks: Handling search when the ToC is missing or stale
Reviewing search requirements and acceptance criteria
